reuse.why: The actions reuse category selection, sign conversion, budget writes and undo wrappers, but introduce separate group-note storage instead of using the existing notes system.

duplication.why: Eligibility rules remain centralized and the new action shares the existing sign-conversion helper without duplicating decision logic.

placement.why: Budget policy and handler registration follow existing layers, but adding category_groups.notes conflicts with the established notes-table ownership of group notes.

scope.why: The changes address the requested budget actions, apart from an unrelated schedules import reorder.

maintainability.why: The shared eligibility helper is straightforward to extend, but maintaining two representations of group notes creates unnecessary ambiguity.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The migration and getBulkBudgetCategories introduce and read category_groups.notes, bypassing the notes table and notes-save/notes-get abstraction already used by group NotesButton instances.

disguised_duplication.where: The diff keeps eligibility and sign decisions shared rather than disguising copied logic.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories replaces includeHidden with includeHiddenCategories, retains skipMissingGroup, and applies the additional exclusions centrally; every month-wide action uses it.
